question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹2,000 at 6% per annum rate of interest for the period from 3 February 2023 to 17 April 2023.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹2,000

Rate of Interest (R) = 6% per annum

Time (T) = From 3 February 2023 to 17 April 2023

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P times R times T)/(100)
